name: Hime
source: A mysterious woman said to live in the wasteland[Spoiler] and control the hollows. She was born deformed and labeled as an imigo—a child touched by the corruption. It's rumored she can heal any wound and has lived for more than 500 years.[/spoiler]
translation: A mysterious woman said to live in the wasteland[Spoiler] and control the hollows. She was born deformed and labeled as an imigo—a child touched by the corruption. It's rumored she can heal any wound and has lived for more than 500 years.[/spoiler]
